newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech c.bank cuts 2-wk rev repo rate to 15.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech c.bank cuts 2-wk rev repo rate to 15.7 pct.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) said on Tuesday it would drain liquidity from the local money market through a two-week reverse repo tender with the maximum rate set at 15.7 percent, down from 16.0 percent in a similar tender on Monday.
The CNB said it would accept up to two bids from each party totalling at least 100 million crowns until the deadline at 9.45 a.m. (0745 GMT).
